name: All For Climate
summary: Belgian non-profit that hosts European citizen groups without a legal entity, so they can receive donations and grants in euros.

evidence.quote: We created a non-profit in Brussels that acts as a fiscal host for groups working toward a more sustainable and just future.
We created a non-profit in Brussels that acts as a fiscal host for groups working toward a more sustainable and just future.

projects.value: Citizen groups and movements doing ecological or social work, not for profit

evidence.quote: We welcome a broad range of efforts that support ecological and social well-being. The activities of your collective have a non-profit purpose.
You are based in Europe. Since the bank account is based in Belgium, you can only collect euros.

value.note: for groups with no legal entity of their own

evidence.quote: If your group already has a legal entity, then you don't need All for Climate. You cannot use All for Climate as a way to channel the money to another legal entity

fees.value: 6% of donations for small groups: fewer than 15 donations a year and a budget under €1000

evidence.quote: Small Collectives (fewer than 15 donations per year and an annual budget under €1000) have a host fee of 6%.
Large Collectives (more than 15 donations per year and an annual budget above €1000) have a host fee of 8%.

fees.value: 8% or 10% of a grant, by how much work All For Climate does on it

evidence.quote: A4C needs to sign final reports 8% 10% fee

fees.value: Card and PayPal fees on top

evidence.quote: When donors use automatic payments or PayPal, additional transaction fees apply.

value.note: The group applies; All For Climate signs the grant agreement.

evidence.quote: A board member of A4C will sign the official grant agreement and any supporting documents required by the funder.

value.note: freelancers can be paid for a defined task

evidence.quote: As a collective, you cannot hire someone on behalf of the fiscal host, but you can hire a freelancer for a well defined task, for a defined amount of time.

conditions.value: At least two administrators, with a gender balance

evidence.quote: When you apply, add at least a second person as an admin of your collective. We advice a team of 3 or 4 administrators. Make sure you have a gender balance in the administrator team.

conditions.value: Never apply for a grant in All For Climate’s name

evidence.quote: Collectives must not apply in the name of A4C.

conditions.value: Join its general assemblies, 2 to 3 times a year

evidence.quote: You are willing to participate in the general assemblies of AllForClimate, organised 2 to 3 times a year.

steps.value: Apply on its Open Collective page, with a second administrator

evidence.quote: Apply on https://opencollective.com/allforclimate/apply and add at least a second administrator.
In this 45 minute call we meet face to face, we answer questions and help you launch you collective. After this call, we approve your application.
